body:
User asked (verbatim):
  the extio is bugy

  i am logge as admin in normal tab https://staging-app.franchisepartner.com/

  and then i have 2 proifles s1, s2 each there own tab

  i remove hte site in s2 and add again it also loas as admin@ifpghub.demo as s1 lol

  but instead i want to logi as wluce@tworld.demo but i remove the already aded site in s2 maybe it does not forget or use exist cookie i am conrsud

  (password given for both demo users; stored in gopass ifpg/atlas/stag/DEMO_ACCOUNTS_PASSWORD, not repeated here)

Context:
  URL/page: https://staging-app.franchisepartner.com/
  Files: apps/extension/src/engine/service.ts (removeSite/addSite), engine/rules-sync, engine/capture, content shim
  Conversation thread: right after the tab-group fix (uncommitted in the working tree).

Acceptance:
  With the browser signed in as admin and persona s1 as admin, removing the site from persona s2 and adding it again opens it signed out in s2, so the user can sign in there as wluce@tworld.demo; covered by an e2e check that fails without the fix.
title: Re-added site in a second persona signs in as the browser/first persona's user
